MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 9
   C. 3
   D. 6

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

3. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 16

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

6. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

7. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 7

9. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 13

10. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 5

11. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 8

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
